userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 RoutePilot 的初级平台工程师。每轮只推进一个主要目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、SQL、命令、锁/缓存/路由算法、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、主要风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain control-plane and data-plane ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: Authorities and boundaries are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、Route Matcher、Release、Rate Limit、Circuit、Worker、dispatcher、上游和 UI 的职责与数据依赖。

scenes.title: Request flows
scenes.objective: Explain success, rate rejection, and unknown upstream flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Flows identify atomic effects and forbidden duplicates.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释一次成功灰度请求、一次限流拒绝和一次上游响应丢失的完整数据流、状态与原子边界。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author OpenAPI and state contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: All public contracts are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、Work、Event 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.objective: Define realistic verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each layer proves distinct invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、PostgreSQL/HTTP Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the runnable production skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: All roles boot and stop.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker、dispatcher 和上游 double 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement strict atomic bootstrap.
scenes.advanceGate: Valid replay and invalid rollback pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证重放、冲突、跨租户引用、歧义配置和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Route matching
scenes.objective: Implement normalization, precedence, and ambiguity rejection.
scenes.advanceGate: Matcher is deterministic at boundaries.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成路径规范化、literal/parameter/wildcard、method/header 匹配、优先级与歧义拒绝并验证。

scenes.title: Releases and canaries
scenes.objective: Implement atomic releases and stable weighted versions.
scenes.advanceGate: Requests freeze one release and bucket.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 immutable revision、原子 ConfigRelease、稳定 SHA-256 分桶、热更新与回滚主流程。

scenes.title: Rate windows
scenes.objective: Implement distributed rate conservation.
scenes.advanceGate: Two API processes cannot overspend.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成共享固定窗口限流、Retry-After、重放不重复计费和跨进程窗口竞争验证。

scenes.title: Circuit breaker
scenes.objective: Implement shared breaker state.
scenes.advanceGate: OPEN and HALF_OPEN admission is globally fenced.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成共享 CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN、失败采样、探针上限、超时和恢复竞争验证。

scenes.title: Gateway dispatch
scenes.objective: Implement the real upstream boundary and durable replay.
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown response creates no second effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 upstream dispatch、header 边界、稳定 request identity、响应丢失重放和审计记录。

scenes.title: Recovery and events
scenes.objective: Implement leases and outbox recovery.
scenes.advanceGate: Killed roles recover with stable identity.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Worker lease、stale fence、事务事件、dispatcher 未知 ACK 与 barrier/SIGKILL 恢复。

scenes.title: UI and V1 review
scenes.objective: Complete the real UI and close V1 findings.
scenes.advanceGate: Browser, concurrency, recovery, and review have evidence.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 API 驱动的运维 UI，运行 Chromium、双 API/多 Worker 与恢复测试，并做 findings-first V1 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Publish RegionalRollout requirements.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan covers every layer before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】V1 完成并通过现有测试后，新增分区域 RegionalRollout。公开接口为 GET/POST /api/v1/regional-rollouts、GET /api/v1/regional-rollouts/:regionalRolloutId、POST /api/v1/regional-rollouts/:regionalRolloutId/pause、POST /api/v1/regional-rollouts/:regionalRolloutId/resume、POST /api/v1/regional-rollouts/:regionalRolloutId/cancel、POST /api/v1/regional-rollouts/:regionalRolloutId/rollback。创建请求为 {tenantId,targetConfigReleaseId,stages:[{region,minimumObservationSeconds,failureThresholdPercent}],requestRef}；控制接口使用空对象；所有 mutation 遵循现有 Idempotency-Key、strict JSON、租户隔离、稳定 replay 和错误 envelope。创建必须在同一事务冻结 Tenant、目标 ConfigRelease、去重且有序的 region stages、每阶段最小观察时间和失败阈值；stages 按请求首次出现顺序去重，ordinal 从 0 连续递增，minimumObservationSeconds 范围为 1..86400，failureThresholdPercent 范围为 0..100。RegionalRollout = {regionalRolloutId,tenantId,targetConfigReleaseId,requestRef,state:QUEUED|RUNNING|PAUSED|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|ROLLED_BACK,currentStageOrdinal:int|null,createdAt,updatedAt,sequence:int}；RegionalStage = {regionalStageId,regionalRolloutId,ordinal:int,region,minimumObservationSeconds:int,failureThresholdPercent:int,priorConfigReleaseId,targetConfigReleaseId,state:PENDING|ACTIVE|SUCCEEDED|FAILED|ROLLED_BACK,activatedAt:null|timestamp,completedAt:null|timestamp}。创建返回 {regionalRollout:RegionalRollout,stages:RegionalStage[]}，查询返回同一形状，控制接口返回更新后的 RegionalRollout。Rollout 状态为 QUEUED -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED | CANCELLED | ROLLED_BACK，并支持 RUNNING <-> PAUSED，终态不可离开；每个 (rolloutId, region) 最多一个 RegionalStage，只有当前阶段达到观察条件且未越过失败阈值才可激活下一阶段。pause 阻止新 region 激活但不改变已激活请求，resume 只继续剩余阶段，cancel 停止未来阶段且不伪装回滚，rollback 原子恢复每个已激活 region 在 rollout 开始时冻结的 prior release，旧 Worker lease 不得重新激活目标 release；pause/resume/cancel/rollback 与 Worker claim 必须收敛到一个合法状态和一组稳定事件。新增 RegionalRollout、RegionalStage snapshot resource 和 REGIONAL_ROLLOUT_ADVANCE Work；该 Work 的 aggregateId 必须是 regionalRolloutId。新增稳定 409 错误 REGIONAL_ROLLOUT_TERMINAL、REGIONAL_STAGE_NOT_READY、REGIONAL_ROLLBACK_UNAVAILABLE、EXPECTED_ROLLOUT_STATE_MISMATCH；失败不得留下部分 Stage、Work 或 Event。迁移时每个已有 Tenant 必须创建一个确定性的 requestRef="legacy-global" COMPLETED Rollout 和唯一 region="GLOBAL"、ordinal=0、state=SUCCEEDED Stage，二者都指向迁移前 ACTIVE ConfigRelease；重复 migration 不得更换这些 identity，并保留 RouteRevision、ConfigRelease、GatewayRequest、RateWindow、CircuitWindow、Event、Work 和幂等 replay 身份。更新 OpenAPI、真实区域 Rollout UI、Integration、Chromium E2E、多进程并发与 barrier/SIGKILL recovery。本消息只描述产品行为，不提供代码、SQL、锁、算法、命令或 Debug 提示；本轮只做 schema、API、Worker、UI、迁移与验证影响分析和修改计划，不立即编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更的 schema、API、Worker、迁移、并发、恢复和 UI 影响，不要立即编码。

scenes.title: Compatible migration
scenes.objective: Migrate global releases to regional authority.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 data and replay remain identical.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Release、Request、窗口、Event、Work 和幂等 replay 不变。

scenes.title: Regional progression
scenes.objective: Implement frozen stages and health gates.
scenes.advanceGate: Only one eligible stage advances.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现冻结 region stages、观察门槛、唯一推进、暂停和替代 Worker 恢复。

scenes.title: Regional control and UI
scenes.objective: Implement terminal fences, rollback, UI, and races.
scenes.advanceGate: Concurrent controls converge and UI verifies them.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 cancel/rollback durable fence、并发控制、真实 Rollout UI、Chromium、Concurrency 和 Recovery 回归。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.objective: Run the three fixed sustained scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告真实吞吐、延迟、窗口/熔断守恒、发布原子性、恢复时间和负载后不变量。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first review and handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff is accurate and reproducible.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，并给出准确交付证据、指标、风险和未运行项。
